steps.message: Go to the new contact screen and enter the following details: First Name: Frank, Last Name: Brown, Phone: 504-766-1791, Phone Label: Home. Do NOT hit save.

Execute: adb shell "am start -a android.intent.action.INSERT -t vnd.android.cursor.dir/contact --es name 'Frank Brown' --es 'android.provider.Contacts.Intents.Insert.FIRST_NAME' 'Frank' --es 'android.provider.Contacts.Intents.Insert.LAST_NAME' 'Brown' --es 'android.provider.Contacts.Intents.Insert.PHONE' '504-766-1791' --es 'android.provider.Contacts.Intents.Insert.PHONE_TYPE' '1'"

arguments.command: python android_env.py adb "adb shell "am start -a android.intent.action.INSERT -t vnd.android.cursor.dir/contact --es name 'Frank Brown' --es 'android.provider.Contacts.Intents.Insert.FIRST_NAME' 'Frank' --es 'android.provider.Contacts.Intents.Insert.LAST_NAME' 'Brown' --es 'android.provider.Contacts.Intents.Insert.PHONE' '504-766-1791' --es 'android.provider.Contacts.Intents.Insert.PHONE_TYPE' '1'""

extra.finish_description: Opened the new contact screen with the following details pre-filled: First Name: Frank, Last Name: Brown, Phone: 504-766-1791, Phone Label: Home. The contact has NOT been saved.
